label: Actual reception of a bearer's esse entails its actuality in the same respect
paraphrase: Open analyst interpretation. For every bearer x and principle z, if x's act of being is received in z, then x is in act in the supplied respect of esse. The premise concerns actual receipt in a represented principle and requires the bearer to be in act in esse. An aptitude for reception can be assigned to a merely possible subject. No claim of external origin, modal contingency or a selected world's existence is included.
